key_highlights: ASX futures point higher following Wall Street tech and AI rebound, supported by ANZ's robust $7.3B full-year profit.
Severe domestic macroeconomic headwinds persist as residential property records Australia's steepest downturn amid restrictive RBA monetary settings.
Aviation and transport under pressure from escalating fuel costs, with Qantas absorbing a $1B fuel surge, while gold equities see heavy capital raising activity.

sectors.trend: Resilient bank earnings offset by escalating mortgage stress and historic property price downturn.
sectors.implications: ANZ.AX shows solid headline profitability, but credit growth faces contraction and bad debt provisioning risk mounts across major banks.

sectors.trend: Renewed global AI momentum driving local tech and data centre infrastructure demand.
sectors.implications: Positive flow-through to high-growth tech and infrastructure plays like NEXTDC (NXT.AX) tracking US AI recovery.

sectors.trend: Active equity capital markets in gold and selective exploration momentum in critical minerals.
sectors.implications: Gold producers (NST.AX, EVN.AX) benefit from heightened institutional equity issuance and safe-haven flows; base metals remain volatile.

sectors.trend: Margin squeeze from cost-of-living strain and input cost inflation, notably jet fuel.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX facing $1B fuel headwind forcing capacity cuts and fare hikes; retail department store distress signals discretionary retail fragility.

sectors.trend: Deepening residential downturn, developer collapses, and structural retail anchor headwinds.
sectors.implications: Subdued valuation outlook for retail landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX) and residential property developers amidst tight monetary policy.

key_themes: Stagflationary pressures and RBA policy lag depressing household consumption and property valuations.
Corporate divergence between cash-generative majors (banks, tech infrastructure) and cost-pressured transport/retail.
Accelerated capital raising cycle across mid-cap gold and critical minerals developers.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight residential property developers and non-bank lenders; favour well-capitalised Tier-1 banks with strong CET1 ratios.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Input Cost Inflation and Jet Fuel Shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport and industrial exposure; avoid unhedged operators vulnerable to margin erosion.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Macroeconomic Stagnation and Weak Consumer Demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive consumer staples (WOW.AX, COL.AX) and high-quality utilities over discretionary retail.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on AI Infrastructure and Cloud Expansion
opportunities.rationale: Global tech rebound and persistent data centre demand underpin defensive growth for infrastructure operators.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate Precious Metals Producers on Capital Placement Dips
opportunities.rationale: High equity financing activity and macro uncertainty provide attractive entry points in liquid gold miners.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Retail REITs and Cyclical Discretionary
defensive_moves.rationale: Anchor department store closures and household cash-flow contraction threaten mall leasing spreads and footfall.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Airlines and Transportation on Fuel Surge
defensive_moves.rationale: A $1B fuel escalation limits earnings visibility and restricts domestic capacity expansion.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 (^AXJO) trading around key technical levels as offshore tech tailwinds clash with domestic credit and housing weakness.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued earnings growth across domestic cyclical sectors until RBA pivots away from restrictive policy and consumer balance sheets stabilise.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and interest rate trajectory
Full-year major bank earnings and net interest margin (NIM) reporting
Crude oil and jet fuel price developments impacting transport margins
Australian quarterly GDP and household spending data
watch_list: RBA official cash rate and CPI prints
National home value index and auction clearance rates
Global tech earnings and AI capex commitments
